card.name: Author words in study reports
card.fires_on: The word author (also co-author, authors, lead author) when a news piece or report names who wrote a study or bill. Also weakly on a few other nouns like scanned or magazines.

modes.label: Author nouns
modes.description: Author, co-author or authors naming who wrote a paper, report or bill.
modes.example: Two of the study’s<< authors>> are Chunqi Jiang, a research assistant

modes.label: Scanned or magazines
modes.description: Isolated nouns or verbs in document-style text, such as scanned in a PDF note or magazines in regulations.
